MisterGelwe announces the availability of a game editor and links a [demonstration video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TesnFo2jijk). The embedded description identifies it as Spellforge by YetiWizard and credits community testers.

This is a dated community announcement, not a demonstrated inventory of editor features; the video was not watched. See the separately inspected [Spellforge documentation](../technical/rhmods-spellforge.md) for stated capabilities and limitations.
